description: This Java source file defines the 'StreamThings' command class within the Eclipse Ditto project. The class is used to initiate or resume a search stream of thing IDs, supporting filtering, sorting, and namespace selection, with serialization/deserialization capabilities to and from JSON. It is part of the 'thingsearch' query commands and contains metadata, builder methods, and logic for handling command payloads.

classes.name: StreamThings
classes.description: Immutable command class used to start or resume a stream of thing ID search results, supporting filtering, namespace selection, and sort options. Provides methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, and for creating modified instances with new parameters.
